author: Archivist, U.S. Naval Chaplaincy School
credit: Archivisit, U.S. Naval Chaplaincy School, Armed Forces Chaplaincy Center
description: The sign for the Peacekeeping Chapel, Beirut, Lebanon, during the time that U.S. forces were part of the International Peacekeeping Force. On October 23, 1983, when a suicide bomber drove a truck laden with explosions into the Marine Barracks, this portion of the sign survived. It is part of the historical collection at the U.S. Naval Chaplaincy School and Center, on the campus of the Armed Forces
